commit.subject: DRAFT LU-21180 lod: add kunit lod_buf_test
commit.message:
DRAFT LU-21180 lod: add kunit lod_buf_test

Add lod_buf_test, covering per-thread LOD buffer lifecycle helpers
and the DoM-stripe-entry removal helper: buffer growth, no-op on a
smaller request, release, and removing a DoM component entry and its
data blob from an in-memory composite layout.

Functions tested:
- lod_ea_store_resize()
- lod_def_striping_comp_resize()
- lod_free_def_comp_entries()
- lod_erase_dom_stripe()

Test-Parameters: trivial
Signed-off-by: Ronnie Sahlberg <rsahlberg@whamcloud.com>
Assisted-by: AGENT:claude-sonnet-4.5 [augment-cli]
